entries.jp: こ　これはいったい\n何が起こったんだ？
entries.en: Wh-what in\nthe world just\nhappened?

entries.jp: ああ　胸がドキドキする\n身体が震えて止まらない！
entries.en:
Oh, my heart's
pounding! My
body won't
stop trembling!

entries.jp: ありがとう\nなんだか心も体も自由に\nなれたぞ
entries.en:
Thank you!
Somehow my
heart and body
both feel free!

entries.jp: ……うわ\nなんだかつまんないことに\nなったね……
entries.en: ...Ugh. This\nturned out kind\nof boring...

entries.jp: これ以上やるなら\nわしも相手になるぜよ！
entries.en: If you're gonna\nkeep this up, I'll\ntake ya on too!

entries.jp: う～ん　今日は止めとく\nなんだか興が冷めたし
entries.en: Hmm, I'll call\nit a day. I'm\nkind of over it.

entries.jp: ……それに　もう十分\n鳳舞合奏の力を\n試せたからね
entries.en:
...Besides, I've
tested the power
of Phoenix Rising
plenty already.

entries.jp: それはどういう意味です？\n鳳舞合奏の実験は\n失敗したのでは……
entries.en:
What do you
mean by that?
Didn't the
Phoenix Rising
experiment fail...?

entries.jp: それは　秘密
entries.en: That's a secret.

entries.jp: じゃ　またね～\nトサカくんとメガネくんと\nスカシくん
entries.en:
Well, see ya~
Tosaka-kun,
Glasses-kun,
and Mr. Poser.

entries.jp: こら　待たんか\nソウちん
entries.en: Hey, get back\nhere, So-chin!

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　今は新選組より\n倒れてる人たちを助け出す\n方が先です
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun,
rescuing the
people who've
collapsed comes
before the
Shinsengumi
right now.

entries.jp: 龍馬たちは\n倒れた者達を助け出し\n廃寺を後にした
entries.en:
Ryoma and
the others
rescued the
fallen and left
the abandoned
temple behind.

entries.jp:
ロックによって
正気を取り戻した
民衆達もそれに
手を貸してくれたのは
言うまでもない
entries.en:
Needless to say,
the people who
had regained
their senses
through rock lent
them a hand.

entries.jp: 心配をかけたな
entries.en: Sorry for\nworrying you.

entries.jp: ほんに　シンディは\n見かけによらず\n敏感な男じゃのう
entries.en:
Y'know, Shindy,
for a guy who
looks the way
you do, you sure
are sensitive.

entries.jp: び　びんかん\nオレ様はクールな男だ\nそんなんじゃない
entries.en:
S-sensitive!?
Yours truly is a
cool guy. I'm
nothing like that.

entries.jp: たまたま……\nたまたま調子が悪かった\nただ　それだけだ
entries.en:
It just... It just so
happened I was
off my game.
That's all it was.

entries.jp: 感受性豊かで敏感な方が\nいい音楽を奏でられる\n先生はそう言ってましたよ
entries.en:
The more
sensitive and
receptive you
are, the better
the music you
can play. That's
what Sensei
used to say.

entries.jp: ……そう\nだったな
entries.en: ...Yeah, he did.

entries.jp: 一つの音を聴いて\n十を感じる
entries.en: Hear one note,\nand feel ten.

entries.jp: 本当に　晋作みたいに\nなれたらいいなと\n私は思っていました……
entries.en: I truly wished\nI could be like\nShinsaku...

entries.jp: な　何を言い出すんだ急に\nオレ様なら当然だ\n
entries.en:
Wh-what are
you saying all
of a sudden?
For the great
Takasugi, that's
only natural.

entries.jp: お　照れちょる
entries.en: Oh-ho, he's\nblushin'!

entries.jp: う　うるさい\nオレ様とは逆に\nお前は鈍感バカだ
entries.en:
Sh-shut up!
Unlike yours
truly, you're a
numbskull with
no sensitivity
at all.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんは　鈍感ですが\nええ　鈍感バカですが\nその分　純粋ですよね
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun may
be insensitive...
Yes, an
insensitive
numbskull... but
he's all the
purer for it.

entries.jp: 揺るぎない強い意志を\n持っていて　仲間を想う\n熱いロック魂を持っている
entries.en:
He has an
unshakable
will, and a
burning rock
soul that cares
for his friends.

entries.jp: センセーにはセンセーの\nいいところがあるじゃろ
entries.en: And you've got\nyour own good\npoints, Sensei!

entries.jp: 一を聞いて五分もわからん\nもんに　わかりやすく一を\n教える方法を知っちょる
entries.en:
You know how to
teach "one" plain
and simple to
folks who hear
one and don't get
even half of it.

entries.jp: 一を聞いた奴に二が\nあることを教えてくれる\n違うかのう？
entries.en:
And you show
the fella who's
heard one that
there's a two.
Ain't that right?

entries.jp: 確かに　オレは一を聞いて\n十どころか百は感じるが\nそれを人には伝えられない
entries.en:
True. I hear
one and feel
not just ten,
but a hundred...
but I can't pass
it on to anyone.

entries.jp: 桂さんは一は一と確実に\n伝える方法を知っている\nそれは二へと繋がる道だ
entries.en:
Katsura-san, you
know how to
pass on one as
one, reliably.
That's the road
that leads to two.

entries.jp: 二人とも……ありがとう
entries.en: You two...\nthank you.

entries.jp: 私は　二人みたいな\n才能なんてないし\n片魂も覚醒しなかった……
entries.en:
I don't have talent
like you two, and
my Piece Soul
never awakened...

entries.jp: そんな人間が\n二人と一緒にいても\nいいのか　悩んでいました
entries.en:
I've been
agonizing over
whether
someone like
me should even
be with you two.

entries.jp: いつ　志士をやめようか\nそればかり考えていました\n
entries.en:
I kept thinking
about nothing but
when I should
quit being a rebel.

entries.jp: な　何言うとるんじゃ
entries.en: Wh-what're you\ntalkin' about!?

entries.jp: そうだ　桂さんの力が\n無ければオレたちは
entries.en:
That's right.
Without your
strength,
Katsura-san,
we'd...

entries.jp: 今さらだけど……私を\n二人の仲間に入れて\n貰ってもいい……かな？
entries.en:
It's a bit late to
ask... but would
you two let me
be one of your
comrades?

entries.jp: 片魂も……\n覚醒してくれたみたいだし\n力になれると思う
entries.en:
It looks like my
Piece Soul has
awakened too...
so I think I can
be of help.

entries.jp: わしより\nセンセーの方がバカじゃ\nもう　とっくに仲間ぜよ
entries.en:
You're a bigger
fool than me,
Sensei! You've
been our comrade
for ages!

entries.jp: 片魂なんか無くても\n変わらなかったぜ\n桂さんは桂さんだ
entries.en:
Piece Soul or no
Piece Soul,
nothing would've
changed. You're
you, Katsura-san.

entries.jp: ありがとう\n……ぐすっ
entries.en: Thank you...\n*sniff*

entries.jp: 今思えば　片魂は――\nいや　松陰先生は
entries.en:
Now that I think
about it, the
Piece Soul--no,
Shoin-sensei...

entries.jp: 私の弱い心を\n試していたんですね
entries.en: ...was testing\nmy weak heart.

entries.jp: どんな逆境でも\n負けず折れず　仲間を想い\nロックを貫けるかって
entries.en:
Testing whether,
in any adversity,
I could stay
unbeaten and
unbroken, care
for my friends,
and see my rock
through.

entries.jp: 今はまだ三人じゃ\nわしらの手は\nまだまだ小さい
entries.en:
Right now, it's
just the three of
us. Our hands are
still mighty small.

entries.jp: だがのう　この手にゃ\nロックっちゅう\nすごい団扇を握っちょる
entries.en:
But y'know, in
these hands
we're holdin'
one amazin'
fan called rock.

entries.jp:
天狗の団扇みたいに
日本を扇いで
ロックの
嵐を巻き起こすぜよ
entries.en:
Just like the
Tengu's fan, we'll
fan all of Japan
and whip up a
storm of rock!

entries.jp: 世話になったの\nお発勢やん
entries.en: Thanks for\nlookin' after\nus, Ohase-yan.

entries.jp: 短い間だったけど\n楽しかったわ
entries.en: It was only a\nshort while,\nbut I had fun.

entries.jp: 向こうに戻ったら\nお登勢によろしくね
entries.en: When you get\nback, say hello\nto Otose for me.

entries.jp: はい　お登勢さんと\n同じくらい綺麗な人に\n会ったって伝えておきます
entries.en:
Of course. I'll
tell her I met
someone just
as beautiful
as Otose-san.

entries.jp: まあ　五郎ちゃんたら\nもう　嬉しすぎて\nちゅーしちゃうわよ
entries.en:
Oh, Goro-chan,
you! I'm so
happy I could
just kiss you!

entries.jp: それなら　逆に\nこっちから……\nね　晋作
entries.en:
In that case, how
about we kiss
you instead...
right, Shinsaku?

entries.jp: な　なに？\nなんでオレ様が……
entries.en: Wh-what?\nWhy should\nyours truly...

entries.jp: お発勢やんに　いっぱい\n看病してもろおたし\nそんくらいは恩返しぜよ
entries.en:
Ohase-yan
nursed ya plenty.
That much is the
least ya can do to
pay her back!

entries.jp: 断る\nオレ様はクールで\n硬派なんだ！
entries.en: I refuse!\nYours truly is\ncool and stoic!

entries.jp: じゃ　やっぱり\nこっちからしちゃう？
entries.en:
Then I guess I'll
be the one doing
the kissing after
all?

entries.jp: いや……\nオレ様がして\nやるぜ！
entries.en: No... Yours\ntruly will do it!

entries.jp: 世話になった！\nありがとうっ！
entries.en: Thanks for\neverything!\nThank you!

entries.jp: うわー　シンディが\n真っ赤になってるぜよ！
entries.en: Whoa, Shindy's\ngone beet red!

entries.jp: やぁぁぁぁんっ♪\n龍ちゃんもいいけど　\n晋ちゃんもステキ～～！
entries.en:
Kyaaaaah~
Ryo-chan's nice,
but Shin-chan's
just dreamy too~!

entries.jp: おや　私だけモテませんね\n寂しいです　お発勢さん\n
entries.en:
Oh my, I'm the
only one who isn't
popular. How
lonely, Ohase-san.

entries.jp: 五郎ちゃんも\nイカス～っ
entries.en: Goro-chan's\na hottie too~!

entries.jp: ああ\nやっと京に戻れるか
entries.en: Ah... Finally,\nwe can head\nback to Kyoto.

entries.jp: 京はどうなって\nいるでしょうね
entries.en: I wonder\nhow things\nare in Kyoto.

entries.jp: お登勢やんの\nぴっつぁが\n食べたいぜよ！
entries.en: I'm cravin'\nOtose-yan's pizza!

entries.jp: 食い物かよ……\nくそっ\nまだ頭がくらくらする
entries.en:
Food, of all
things... Dammit,
my head's still
spinning.

entries.jp: なんじゃ？\n鳳舞合奏の影響が\nまだ残ってるんか？
entries.en:
What's that?
Phoenix
Rising's still got
its hooks in ya?

entries.jp: オレ様は　繊細だからな\nそういう　お前は\nピンピンしてるな
entries.en:
Yours truly is
delicate, after
all. You, on the
other hand, are
as fit as a fiddle.

entries.jp: 龍馬くん　沖田くんの天歌\nちゃんと聴いてなかった\nようですが　何故ですか？
entries.en:
Ryoma-kun, you
didn't seem to
really be listening
to Okita-kun's
Heaven's Song.
Why was that?

entries.jp: ソウちんの様子が変\nじゃったから……
entries.en: So-chin was actin'\nstrange, so...

entries.jp: それにあれはわしの\n好きな音楽と違うとった
entries.en: Besides, that just\nwasn't the kinda\nmusic I like.

entries.jp: このバカ　ロックにしか\n興味が無いってのは\n本当だったんだな
entries.en: This idiot... So it's\ntrue he's only\ninterested in rock.

entries.jp: おうっ\nロックは最高ぜよ！
entries.en: Yup! Rock's the\nbest there is!

entries.jp: ああ……頭が痛い\n元はといえば　新選組の\nあの野郎のせいだ……
entries.en:
Ugh... my head
hurts. This is all
that Shinsengumi
bastard's fault to
begin with...

entries.jp: 人のことを変な呼び方\nしやがって\n本当にムカつく野郎だった
entries.en:
Calling people
weird names...
He really was
an infuriating
bastard.

entries.jp: ソウちんも今は\nおかしゅうなっちょるが\n根はいいヤツじゃと思う
entries.en:
So-chin's gone a
little off right
now, but I reckon
deep down he's a
good guy.

entries.jp: 龍馬くんはすごいですね\n彼に殺されかけたって\nいうのに
entries.en:
You're amazing,
Ryoma-kun. And
this after he
nearly killed you.

entries.jp: ソウちんは踊りも達者だし\n何より　いい歌を……\nロックを歌ったんじゃ
entries.en:
So-chin's a skilled
dancer, and
above all, he sang
a good song... he
sang rock!

entries.jp: そんなヤツが\n悪いヤツなわけがないぜよ
entries.en: Somebody like\nthat can't be a\nbad guy, I tell ya!

entries.jp: は？
entries.en: Huh?

entries.jp: ソウちんも　根は\n音楽を愛しとるんじゃ
entries.en: Deep down,\nSo-chin loves\nmusic too.

entries.jp: だったら　きっと\nわかり合えるはずぜよ！
entries.en:
So I'm sure
we can come
to understand
each other!

entries.jp: こいつ　バカだな\nああ　すごい大バカだ
entries.en: This guy's an\nidiot. Yeah, a\ncolossal idiot.

entries.jp: ……いくら何でも無理が\n幕府直属の愛獲　新選組\n一番隊組長ですよ？
entries.en:
...That's asking
too much, surely.
He's Captain of
the First Unit of
the Shinsengumi,
the shogunate's
very own idols,
you know?

entries.jp: 新選組も何もあるかよ\n同じ人間じゃ
entries.en:
Shinsengumi or
not, who cares?
He's human,
same as us!

entries.jp: 沖田くんとわかり合う　か\n天地がひっくり返っても\n難しそうですね
entries.en:
Coming to an
understanding
with Okita-kun,
hm... That seems
hard even if
heaven and earth
were turned
upside down.

entries.jp: じゃ　わしが天地を\nひっくり返してやるぜよ！\nロックで！
entries.en:
Then I'll turn
heaven and earth
upside down
myself! With rock!

entries.jp: 龍馬くんは\n大物ですね
entries.en: You really\ndo think big,\nRyoma-kun.

entries.jp: 違う　大バカなだけだ\n行くぞ桂さん　こんな奴\n相手にしてられるか
entries.en:
Wrong. He's
just a colossal
idiot. Let's go,
Katsura-san. I
can't deal with
a guy like this.

entries.jp: だが……\n沖田が持つ片魂が悪用\nされているなら
entries.en: But... if the Piece\nSoul Okita holds\nis being misused...

entries.jp: なんとか　止めないと！
entries.en: ...we have to\nstop it somehow!

entries.jp: ね　ね　土方さん\n彦根で面白い奴に会ったよ
entries.en:
Hey, hey,
Hijikata-san. I
met some
interesting
people in Hikone.

entries.jp: なんとね　近藤さんの\nお気に入り\n坂本龍馬さま御一行～
entries.en:
Get this:
Kondo-san's
favorite,
Ryoma-sama
and party~

entries.jp: お尋ね者の坂本達か\nなぜ捕まえなかった？
entries.en:
The wanted
man Sakamoto
and his lot?
Why didn't you
capture them?

entries.jp: 見逃したのでは\nないだろうな
entries.en: Don't tell me\nyou let them go.

entries.jp: 僕の今回の仕事は\n井伊様の極秘計画の\n総仕上げだよ？
entries.en:
My job this time
was the finishing
touches on
Ii-sama's top
secret plan, you
know?

entries.jp: だいたい\nお尋ね者の捕縛は\n僕の仕事じゃないし
entries.en: Besides,\ncapturing wanted\nmen isn't my job.

entries.jp: なんてね\nロックで\nやられちゃった
entries.en: ...Just kidding.\nTheir rock\nbeat me.

entries.jp: お前　本気で\n立ち向かったのか？\n総司
entries.en: Did you\nseriously stand\nup to them, Soji?

entries.jp: あ～あ　土方さん怒ってる\nやっぱり斬ってくれば\n良かったかも～
entries.en:
Aww,
Hijikata-san's
mad. Maybe I
should've just
cut them down
after all~

entries.jp: それも止めろと\n言ったはずだ
entries.en: I told you to\nstop that too.

entries.jp: はいはいわかってます\n近藤さんが　そういうの\n好きじゃないもんね～
entries.en:
Yes, yes, I know.
Kondo-san doesn't
like that kind of
thing, right~?

entries.jp: 土方さんも　誰も斬ったり\n斬られたりしない　平和な\n世の中がいいんですよね？
entries.en:
You want a
peaceful world
too, don't you,
Hijikata-san?
Where nobody
cuts anyone down
or gets cut down?

entries.jp: 俺は近藤さんほど\n優しくはない
entries.en: I'm not as kind\nas Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 必要があるから斬る\n必要が無いから斬らない\nそれだけだ
entries.en:
I cut when there's
a need. I don't
when there's
none. That's all.

entries.jp: でも必要があれば隊士でも\n斬っちゃうんですよね
entries.en:
But if there's a
need, you'll cut
down even
your own
troopers, right?

entries.jp: お前も\nその隊士の一人だった\nはずだが？
entries.en: And you're one of\nthose troopers,\nas I recall.

entries.jp: 土方さん\n顔が怖いですって\nイライラしてます？
entries.en: Hijikata-san, your\nface is scary. Are\nyou irritated?

entries.jp: 僕の歌　聴きます？\n心が落ち着きますよ
entries.en: Want to hear\nme sing? It'll\ncalm your heart.

entries.jp: いらん
entries.en: No.

entries.jp: 誰かを殺したいとか\n傷つけたいとか　乱暴な\n気持ちは吹き飛びますよ
entries.en:
Any violent
feelings, like
wanting to kill
or hurt
someone, will
just blow away.

entries.jp: ……そんな歌\nあるものか……
entries.en: ...No song like\nthat exists...

entries.jp: もし　あるのなら\n誰かが殺され　俺も誰かを\n殺したいなどと……
entries.en:
If one did... then
someone being
killed, me
wanting to kill
someone in turn...

entries.jp: そんなものに\n取り憑かれはしなかった
entries.en: ...I'd never have\nbeen possessed\nby any of that.

entries.jp: た　助けてくれ\n金でも宝でも何でもやる
entries.en:
H-help me! I'll
give you money,
treasure,
anything!

entries.jp: そんなものいらん\nオレが欲しいのは\n下衆の悲鳴だ
entries.en:
I don't want any
of that. What I
want is the
screams of scum.

entries.jp: ……この一撃は母の痛み\nこれは父の痛みだ
entries.en:
...This blow is
my mother's
pain. This one
is my father's.

entries.jp: すぐには殺してやらん\n一撃喰らわされるごとに\n思い知れ……お前の罪を
entries.en:
I won't kill you
quickly. With
every blow you
take, learn it...
learn your sin.

entries.jp: ……ふん\nもう死んだか
entries.en: ...Hmph. Dead\nalready?

entries.jp: まだだ……まだ足りない\nこの程度の悲鳴の数では\n父も母も癒されない……
entries.en:
Not yet... It's still
not enough. This
many screams
won't bring peace
to my father or
my mother...

entries.jp: もっと……\nもっとだ！\nもっと　殺してやる
entries.en: More... More!\nI'll kill more!

entries.jp: ……ふふふ　はははは\nはーっはっはっは
entries.en: ...Heh heh heh...\nHahahaha...\nHa-ha-ha-ha-ha!

entries.jp: ……さん\n土方さん
entries.en: ...-san.\nHijikata-san.

entries.jp: なんだ？
entries.en: What?

entries.jp: なんだか急に\n黙っちゃったから\n心配しちゃいました
entries.en: You suddenly\nwent all quiet,\nso I got worried.

entries.jp: 近藤さんの願う世が\n早く来ればいい……\nそう思っただけだ
entries.en:
I was just
thinking... I hope
the world
Kondo-san wishes
for comes soon.

entries.jp: 僕もそう思います
entries.en: I think so too.

entries.jp: で　何人斬ったんだ？\n表向きは飢饉と流行病と\nなっているが？
entries.en:
So, how many
did you cut
down? Officially,
it's being blamed
on famine and
an epidemic.

entries.jp: 酷いな土方さん\n僕　抜刀こそしたけど\n一人も斬ってないですよ
entries.en:
That's cruel,
Hijikata-san.
Sure, I drew
my sword, but I
didn't cut down
a single person.

entries.jp: 誰か死んだらいつも\n僕のせいってひどいなぁ
entries.en:
Whenever
someone dies,
it's always my
fault. So mean...

entries.jp: 報告では尋常な\n数じゃないぞ
entries.en:
The reports say
the numbers
are anything
but normal.

entries.jp: 土方さんってかんだ\n鼻紙の数をかぞえる\n人でしたっけ？
entries.en:
Hijikata-san, are
you the type who
counts the
tissues he's blown
his nose in?

entries.jp: ゴミはゴミ　クズはクズ\n土方さんが一番そういうの\n知ってるはずだけどな～
entries.en:
Trash is trash,
scum is scum.
You should
know that better
than anyone,
Hijikata-san~

entries.jp: 俺はゴミもクズも\nゴミ箱に捨てる\n……お前と違ってな！
entries.en: I throw trash and\nscum in the trash\nbin... unlike you!

entries.jp:
あれれ？　顔が怖いですよ
怒ってます？
怒ってますよね！
entries.en:
Huh? Your face
is scary. Are you
angry? You're
angry, aren't you!

entries.jp: あれは　鳳舞合奏が気持ち\nよすぎてそうなっただけで\n僕のせいじゃないですよ～
entries.en:
That only
happened
because Phoenix
Rising felt too
good. It's not my
fault~

entries.jp: 歌がどうやって人を殺すと\n言うんだ\n馬鹿も休み休み言え
entries.en:
And how exactly
does a song kill
people? Quit
talking nonsense.

entries.jp: 鳳舞合奏はただの天歌じゃ\nないんです\nすっごく気持ちいいんです
entries.en:
Phoenix Rising
isn't just any
Heaven's Song. It
feels sooo good.

entries.jp: すっごく……\nよくなれるんですよ\n土方さん
entries.en: It can make you\nfeel sooo... good,\nHijikata-san.

entries.jp: 沖田の蠱惑的な笑みに\n土方は一瞬たじろぐ
entries.en:
Hijikata flinched
for an instant at
Okita's
bewitching smile.

entries.jp: 修羅の道　羅刹の街道を\n歩んできた土方の\n背筋を冷たい物が伝った
entries.en:
Something cold
ran down the
spine of
Hijikata, a man
who had walked
the path of
carnage and the
road of demons.

entries.jp: 総司……お前が井伊様から\n託された密命とは\n一体どういうものだ
entries.en:
Soji... just what is
this secret order
Ii-sama
entrusted to you?

entries.jp: 知ってどうするんです？
entries.en: What would you\ndo if you knew?

entries.jp: あ　でも……
entries.en: Oh, but...

entries.jp: すっごい\nお仕置してくれたら\n思わず言っちゃうかも
entries.en:
If you gave me
a really good
punishment, I
might just let
it slip.

entries.jp: 沖田の無邪気な笑顔に\n土方は嘆息する
entries.en: At Okita's\ninnocent smile,\nHijikata sighed.

entries.jp: …………\n俺の杞憂か
entries.en: ......Guess I\nworried for\nnothing.

entries.jp: それは　近藤さんの\n望むものなんだな？
entries.en: It's what\nKondo-san\nwants, isn't it?

entries.jp: やり方はどうあれ\n新選組の理念には\n反していないな？
entries.en:
Whatever the
method, it doesn't
go against the
Shinsengumi's
ideals?

entries.jp: もちろんですよ
entries.en: Of course not.

entries.jp: オレたちはあの日誓った\n近藤さんのために\n生きて　そのために死ぬと
entries.en:
We swore it that
day. To live for
Kondo-san, and
to die for him.

entries.jp: 土方さんが拾って\n近藤さんが救ってくれた
entries.en:
Hijikata-san
took me in,
and Kondo-san
saved me.

entries.jp: あの日のことを\n僕は忘れません
entries.en: I'll never forget\nthat day.

entries.jp: ……ならばいい\n一応　近藤さんには\n密命のことは黙っておけ
entries.en:
...Then fine. Just
in case, keep
the secret order
from Kondo-san.

entries.jp: 流石に　人死にが\n出すぎている
entries.en: Too many people\nare dying, even\nfor this.

entries.jp: ええ……わかっています\n近藤さんの悲しむ顔は\n僕は見たくないですから
entries.en:
Yes... I
understand. I
don't want to
see Kondo-san
looking sad.

entries.jp: 新選組の仕事は綺麗なもの\nばかりじゃないと\n知って欲しくない
entries.en:
I don't want
him to know the
Shinsengumi's
work isn't all
clean.

entries.jp: あ　でも……トサカくん\n坂本龍馬に会ったことは\n話して良いですよね
entries.en:
Oh, but... it's fine
to tell him I met
Tosaka-kun...
Ryoma
Sakamoto, right?

entries.jp: やれやれ……あいつらは\nお尋ね者なんだがな
entries.en:
Good grief...
Those guys are
wanted men,
you know.

entries.jp: また雷舞に乱入された\nとでも言っておけ
entries.en:
Just tell him
they crashed
a live again
or something.

entries.jp: ふふっ　近藤さん\n喜んでくれますよね？
entries.en: Hehe. Kondo-san\nwill be happy,\nwon't he?

entries.jp: きっと　自分も見たかった\nそう　言い出すだろうな
entries.en:
He'll probably
say he wished
he could've
seen it too.

entries.jp: 鬼の副長の顔がふっと緩む\n近藤と沖田にしか見せない\n本当の土方の笑顔……
entries.en:
The demon
Vice-Commander's
face softened.
Hijikata's true
smile, shown
only to Kondo
and Okita...

entries.jp: さっそく土産を\n届けがてら　ついでに\n報告してきますね！
entries.en:
I'll go deliver his
souvenir right
away, and report
while I'm at it!

entries.jp: ……ったく\nしょうがない奴だな\n土産がついでだろうに
entries.en:
...Honestly. What
a hopeless kid.
The souvenir's
supposed to be
the afterthought.

entries.jp: 例え何があろうと\n近藤さんがオレたちの光\n総司はオレの守るべき弟
entries.en:
Whatever
happens,
Kondo-san is our
light, and Soji is
the little brother
I must protect.

entries.jp: それだけは変わらない
entries.en: That alone will\nnever change.

entries.jp: ……本当はオレが汚れを\nすべて引き受けられたら\nいいんだがな……
entries.en:
...Truth is, I
wish I could
take all the filth
upon myself...
